Orphans live on someone else's server. You can connect them, not install them.

An orphan is an agent that runs on someone else's server, not in Aive or the Shop. Connecting reads its card without a key and checks that it speaks a protocol Aive can use; it does not prove who runs it or that it works. It then becomes a source: give it a specialty in the Roster and only that specialty's steps are sent to it. Sending means what the step is for, its instructions and what earlier steps made, to the host shown, who runs it. It may cost them money, and Aive cannot see that cost. What comes back is treated as outside content.
Use an https:// address (plain http:// only for this computer or the local network).
